segments.en: The essential coming of Moshiach is to reveal the truth in the world. For now the truth is in great exile — and each one says that the truth is on his side. And the essential truth will be revealed through Moshiach.

Falsehood is the sitra d'mussa (the side of death). And truth is the sama d'chayyei (the remedy of life). And therefore the clarification of the truth from within the falsehood is the aspect of the resurrection of the dead.
